body:
Founder real-time: "continue to ensure DEADWEIGHT is pixel for pixel the windows version." Closed every gap the prior menu-chrome-only pass named: title now huge/left-aligned matching main.c's own scale-5 treatment with the descriptive text demoted to a subtitle; real hull bars (proportional fill, green-above-1/3-else-red, armor/vault with correct Merkle-Blindness hidden-sentinel handling) and energy pip rows for BOTH sides, plus ROUND N/MAX via PARENA-compiled rules.maxRounds(); hand cards rebuilt with card_box()'s real colored-header-block layout instead of a thin top border; and a real interaction-model fix (checked apps/gui/main.c's click() directly -- clicking a card only selects it, only LOCK IN submits, matching the real select-then-lock-in flow instead of the old immediate-submit-on-click behavior). Found and fixed a real bug (fx.ts's ship fill used the UI panel color instead of fx.c's own distinct DGR color) and corrected a wrong claim in the prior pass's own docs (the ship shape was never actually kind-differentiated in the real client -- only the color is, and fx.ts already matched that exactly). Verified live: a full match played end to end via Playwright/headless Chrome against a real throwaway dw_server+dw_bot+bridge, through the actual compiled dist/client.js/main.js, with ImageMagick-sampled exact hex matches for hull-bar green, and all three kind header colors, and the Lock In button's accent green. Full account: docs/NATIVE_WASM_CLIENT_NORTHSTAR.md.

⚓ ☃
title: Real in-match pixel-for-pixel parity pass on the browser client, live-verified against a real match
